fixture_kind: synthetic CPU reference inputs; not recorded model responses
purpose: Adapt a distilled DeepSeek model and export it for local inference.
mechanism: An Unsloth notebook loads a quantized base model, prepares training examples, fine-tunes and exports for Ollama.
experiment: Compare a fixed baseline prompt suite before tuning, after tuning and after quantized export to expose regressions.
production: Train on ephemeral GPU workers; register the adapter, tokenizer and base revision together and validate the exported artifact.
